text: Artificial intelligence is changing the workplace in many ways. One major change is automation, where machines perform routine tasks that people used to do. This can help companies save time and money. AI also provides useful productivity tools, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, which help workers finish tasks faster. In many jobs, human-AI collaboration is becoming normal. For example, doctors use AI to analyse medical images, but people still make the final decisions. However, some jobs may disappear or change, so workers need to learn new skills. Overall, AI offers both opportunities and challenges for the future of work.
